title: cyanea copelandii subsp. haleakalaensis
intro: Cyanea copelandii subsp. haleakalaensis, commonly known as the Hāmākua cyanea, is a rare, endangered plant species native to Hawaii. It has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Hāmākua cyanea include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
